# Parameters

<!-- Generated by `oxide-sim params doc`. Do not edit by hand: change the table in `crates/oxide-core/src/params.rs` and regenerate. -->

Every tunable value of the flight core is one of these 93 parameters (ADR-0004). Set one for a simulated flight with `--param NAME=VALUE` (repeatable), with `--params FILE.toml` (a `[params]` table of `NAME = value`) or in the `[params]` table of an airframe file; they are applied in that order of increasing priority: airframe file, `--params` file, then the flags. A value outside its range, of the wrong type, or that would break a rule between two parameters is refused and the run does not start. Units are the core's own: radians, metres, seconds, volts. "live" parameters take effect in flight; "disarmed" ones are accepted only while disarmed.

## Rate loop

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RATE_ROLL_P` | Float | 28 | 0 | 200 | 1/s | live | Rate loop proportional gain on roll: angular acceleration demanded per rad/s of rate error. |
| `RATE_PITCH_P` | Float | 28 | 0 | 200 | 1/s | live | Rate loop proportional gain on pitch: angular acceleration demanded per rad/s of rate error. |
| `RATE_YAW_P` | Float | 12 | 0 | 100 | 1/s | live | Rate loop proportional gain on yaw: angular acceleration demanded per rad/s of rate error. |
| `RATE_ROLL_I` | Float | 40 | 0 | 300 | 1/s^2 | live | Rate loop integral gain on roll. |
| `RATE_PITCH_I` | Float | 40 | 0 | 300 | 1/s^2 | live | Rate loop integral gain on pitch. |
| `RATE_YAW_I` | Float | 10 | 0 | 100 | 1/s^2 | live | Rate loop integral gain on yaw. |
| `RATE_ROLL_D` | Float | 0.3 | 0 | 2 |  | live | Rate loop derivative gain on roll, applied to the measurement. |
| `RATE_PITCH_D` | Float | 0.3 | 0 | 2 |  | live | Rate loop derivative gain on pitch, applied to the measurement. |
| `RATE_YAW_D` | Float | 0 | 0 | 1 |  | live | Rate loop derivative gain on yaw, applied to the measurement. |
| `RATE_D_CUTOFF` | Float | 60 | 0 | 500 | Hz | live | Cut-off of the first-order low-pass on the rate loop derivative term. Zero turns it off. |
| `RATE_GYRO_CUTOFF` | Float | 80 | 0 | 500 | Hz | disarmed | Cut-off of the second-order Butterworth low-pass on the gyro for the rate loop. Zero turns it off. The filter is rebuilt when this changes. |

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ATT_ROLL_P` | Float | 6.5 | 0 | 50 | 1/s | live | Attitude loop proportional gain on roll: rate demanded per rad of attitude error. |
| `ATT_PITCH_P` | Float | 6.5 | 0 | 50 | 1/s | live | Attitude loop proportional gain on pitch: rate demanded per rad of attitude error. |

## Limits

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LIM_TILT` | Float | 0.61086524 | 0.01 | 1.39 | rad | live | Maximum tilt in the position and offboard modes. |
| `LIM_TILT_STAB` | Float | 0.7853982 | 0.01 | 1.39 | rad | live | Maximum tilt in the stabilized mode, at full stick. |
| `LIM_RATE_ROLL` | Float | 3.8 | 0.01 | 35 | rad/s | live | Maximum body rate, roll axis. |
| `LIM_RATE_PITCH` | Float | 3.8 | 0.01 | 35 | rad/s | live | Maximum body rate, pitch axis. |
| `LIM_RATE_YAW` | Float | 3.5 | 0.01 | 35 | rad/s | live | Maximum body rate, yaw axis. |
| `LIM_SPEED_XY` | Float | 5 | 0.01 | 30 | m/s | live | Maximum horizontal speed. |
| `LIM_SPEED_UP` | Float | 3 | 0.01 | 30 | m/s | live | Maximum climb speed. |
| `LIM_SPEED_DOWN` | Float | 1.5 | 0.01 | 30 | m/s | live | Maximum descent speed. |
| `LIM_YAW_RATE` | Float | 2 | 0.01 | 35 | rad/s | live | Yaw rate at full yaw stick. |
| `LIM_RATE_I` | Float | 30 | 0 | 1000 | rad/s^2 | live | Limit on the rate loop integral term. |
| `LIM_VEL_I` | Float | 3 | 0 | 30 | m/s^2 | live | Limit on the velocity loop integral term. |
| `LIM_MIN_THRUST` | Float | 0.1 | 0 | 0.99999994 |  | live | Minimum collective thrust while flying, as a fraction of hover thrust. Must stay below LAND_TD_THRUST. |
| `LIM_IDLE` | Float | 0.05 | 0 | 1 |  | live | Motor command while armed with no demand, 0 to 1. |
| `LIM_STICK_DB` | Float | 0.05 | 0 | 0.5 |  | live | Stick deadband: a stick within this of centre reads as centred, and the rest of the travel is rescaled to the full range. |

## State estimator

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EKF_HORIZON` | Float | 0.2 | 0.000001 | 0.5 | s | disarmed | How far the filter runs behind real time. Must exceed the largest GPS latency and fit the profile's IMU buffer. |
| `EKF_GYR_NOISE` | Float | 0.015 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 1 | rad/s | disarmed | Gyro process noise (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_ACC_NOISE` | Float | 0.35 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 10 | m/s^2 | disarmed | Accelerometer process noise (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_GYR_BNOISE` | Float | 0.001 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 0.1 | rad/s^2 | disarmed | Gyro bias random walk. |
| `EKF_ACC_BNOISE` | Float | 0.003 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 1 | m/s^3 | disarmed | Accelerometer bias random walk. |
| `EKF_GPS_POS_N` | Float | 0.5 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 1000 | m | disarmed | Lower bound on the GPS horizontal position noise; the receiver's own accuracy is used when larger. |
| `EKF_GPS_VEL_N` | Float | 0.3 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 100 | m/s | disarmed | Lower bound on the GPS velocity noise. |
| `EKF_BARO_NOISE` | Float | 0.5 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 1000 | m | disarmed | Barometric height noise. |
| `EKF_YAW_NOISE` | Float | 0.15 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 3.1415927 | rad | disarmed | Magnetic heading noise. |
| `EKF_GPS_GATE` | Float | 5 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 100 | sigma | disarmed | GPS innovation gate, in standard deviations. |
| `EKF_BARO_GATE` | Float | 5 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 100 | sigma | disarmed | Barometer innovation gate, in standard deviations. |
| `EKF_YAW_GATE` | Float | 3 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 100 | sigma | disarmed | Heading innovation gate, in standard deviations. |
| `EKF_MAG_DECL` | Float | 0 | -3.1415927 | 3.1415927 | rad | disarmed | Magnetic declination at the site, east positive. |
| `EKF_INIT_TILT` | Float | 0.1 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 3.1415927 | rad | disarmed | Initial tilt uncertainty after alignment (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_YAW` | Float | 0.3 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 3.1415927 | rad | disarmed | Initial yaw uncertainty after alignment (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_VEL` | Float | 0.5 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 100 | m/s | disarmed | Initial velocity uncertainty after alignment (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_POS` | Float | 1 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 1000 | m | disarmed | Initial position uncertainty after alignment (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_GBIAS` | Float | 0.02 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 1 | rad/s | disarmed | Initial gyro bias uncertainty (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_ABIAS` | Float | 0.1 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 10 | m/s^2 | disarmed | Initial accelerometer bias uncertainty (1 sigma). Bounds how far the tilt estimate can wander in hover. |
| `EKF_ALIGN_TIME` | Float | 1 | 0.000001 | 60 | s | disarmed | The vehicle must sit still this long before the filter aligns. |
| `EKF_GPS_TMO` | Float | 5 | 0.000001 | 3600 | s | disarmed | GPS aiding stops after this long without an accepted fix; also how long horizontal velocity stays valid. |
| `EKF_POS_TMO` | Float | 1.5 | 0.000001 | 3600 | s | disarmed | Horizontal position stays valid this long after the last accepted GPS fix. |
| `EKF_BARO_TMO` | Float | 5 | 0.000001 | 3600 | s | disarmed | Height stays valid this long after the last accepted barometer reading. |
| `EKF_MAG_TMO` | Float | 30 | 0.000001 | 3600 | s | disarmed | Heading stays valid this long after the last accepted magnetometer reading. |
| `EKF_OUT_TAU` | Float | 0.25 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 10 | s | disarmed | Time constant with which the output predictor follows the filter. |
| `EKF_SOURCE` | Int32 | 0 | 0 | 1 |  | disarmed | Where the state estimate comes from: 0 external (simulator truth or motion capture), 1 the EKF. |

## Failsafe

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FS_RC_TIMEOUT` | Float | 0.5 | 0.05 | 3600 | s | live | RC counts as lost after this long without a valid frame. |
| `FS_RC_VALID` | Float | 1 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | RC must be valid this long without a gap before pilot input counts (arming, override). |
| `FS_RC_HOLD` | Float | 3 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | After RC loss in a pilot mode: hold this long, then return. |
| `FS_GCS_TIMEOUT` | Float | 3 | 0.05 | 3600 | s | live | The ground station counts as lost after this long without a heartbeat. |
| `FS_NOLINK_RTL` | Float | 60 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | Offboard with no human link: continue this long, then return. |
| `FS_BRAIN_TMO` | Float | 2 | 0.05 | 3600 | s | live | The brain counts as lost when its progress counter has not advanced for this long. |
| `FS_BRAIN_RTL` | Float | 10 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | After brain loss: hold this long, then return. |
| `FS_SETPT_TMO` | Float | 0.5 | 0.05 | 3600 | s | live | Tier-2 setpoints count as stale after this long. |
| `FS_GPS_LAND` | Float | 30 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | After losing position with nobody flying: hold this long, then land. |
| `FS_CLEAR_HYST` | Float | 1 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | A hold ends when its reasons have been clear this long. |
| `FS_FENCE_RAD` | Float | 0 | 0 | 1000000 | m | live | Geofence radius around home. Zero disables it. |
| `FS_FENCE_ALT` | Float | 0 | 0 | 1000000 | m | live | Geofence height above home. Zero disables it. |
| `FS_LOC_ERR` | Float | 0.7853982 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 3.1415927 | rad | live | Loss of control: attitude error above this for FS_LOC_ERR_T. |
| `FS_LOC_ERR_T` | Float | 0.5 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | Loss of control: how long the attitude error must stay above FS_LOC_ERR. |
| `FS_LOC_TILT` | Float | 1.3089969 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 3.1415927 | rad | live | Loss of control: tilt above this for FS_LOC_TILT_T. |
| `FS_LOC_TILT_T` | Float | 0.25 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | Loss of control: how long the tilt must stay above FS_LOC_TILT. |

## Battery

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BAT_LOW_V` | Float | 3.5 | 3 | 4 | V | live | Low battery threshold, volts per cell, on the filtered, load-compensated voltage. Must not be below BAT_CRIT_V. |
| `BAT_CRIT_V` | Float | 3.3 | 3 | 4 | V | live | Critical battery threshold, volts per cell. Must not be above BAT_LOW_V. |
| `BAT_DEBOUNCE` | Float | 2 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | The voltage must stay below a threshold this long to latch. |
| `BAT_FILT_TAU` | Float | 2 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 3600 | s | live | Time constant of the battery voltage low-pass. |

## Landing

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LAND_SPEED` | Float | 0.7 | 0 | 10 | m/s | live | Landing descent rate. Must be at least twice LAND_TD_SPEED. |
| `LAND_BLIND_THR` | Float | 0.9 | 0 | 1 |  | live | Landing without a valid height: thrust as a fraction of hover thrust. Must be above LAND_TD_THRUST. |
| `LAND_TD_THRUST` | Float | 0.3 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 0.99999994 |  | live | Touchdown: thrust below this fraction of hover thrust. Must be above LIM_MIN_THRUST and below LAND_BLIND_THR. |
| `LAND_TD_SPEED` | Float | 0.25 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 5 | m/s | live | Touchdown: vertical speed below this. |
| `LAND_TD_TIME` | Float | 1 | 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 | 3600 | s | live | Touchdown: for this long. |
